purpose: Architecture design-target candidates for Bryson's selection
dimension_status: Brief dimensions are prompt constraints. Generated raster images are visual targets, not measured construction drawings. See README for remaining mismatches.

tasks.title: Target frame A
tasks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: architectural visual target for a realistic Godot stealth-tactics game, Request 31. Generate ONE full-bleed image, not a collage or labeled sheet.
Input images 1-4 are design references for architecture, materials and lighting only: research park terrace, campus overhead, river crossing, robotics lab. Image 5 is a style reference ONLY for the three small people and their backpack computers. Do not copy any logo, emblem or signage from the references.
Subject: a single compact two-storey research laboratory building at a California research park at night, approximately 12 m long by 9 m wide. EXACTLY TWO STOREYS, each 4.5 m floor to floor, flat walkable roof at 9 m. The building envelope must stay a compact rectangular box.
Ground floor: black-framed floor-to-ceiling glass curtain walls, regular 1.5 m mullion spacing, a warmly lit laboratory behind the glass with workbenches and one robot arm.
Upper floor: matte white composite cladding, regular thin dark seams on a 1.5 m module, one long continuous glazed band.
Roof: walkable light-grey paver terrace on a 1.5 m grid; white parapet 1.1 m tall, a frameless glass railing above it and slim black cap; TWO rooftop air-handling units, ONE row of solar panels, ONE low green-roof strip and planters. Keep an open walking area. EXACTLY THREE small stylized people, human scale, in dark practical tactical street clothes with backpack computers, crouching on the roof; their stylization matches image 5.
Outside stair: dark grey steel, a visibly continuous walkable route from ground to the roof at 9 m with an intermediate landing at the upper floor at 4.5 m; two straight flights 1.5 m wide, open steel treads, slender black handrail with vertical balusters, steel stringers and posts. Show the path and both connections, not disconnected fragments.
Skybridge: ONE short enclosed bridge stub leaving the upper floor at the far corner, floor at 4.5 m, 3 m wide and one storey tall, glass walls, black frame, diagonal X bracing, white underside, pale floor and warm linear interior lights. Keep it distinct from the stair and show its connection to the lab.
Surroundings: modest light stone paved apron around the whole building, warm uplights washing the white walls, ONE tall pole light and ONE bench; wet after rain with controlled realistic reflections. Very sparse red: one thin architectural accent line and one or two indicator lights.
Style: realistic contemporary architecture and physically believable materials and lighting, slightly stylized people only. Deep blue night, warm amber interiors and wall washes, clean white panels and charcoal steel. Preserve useful shadow detail for a tactics game. No cyberpunk neon.
Composition: high tactical battle-camera view, approximately 50 degrees DOWN FROM HORIZONTAL, three-quarter view, orthographic or very long lens with nearly parallel verticals, no horizon. Entire building including roof terrace, stair, bridge stub and paved apron visible uncropped with modest clear margin. Architecture fills most of landscape image. Make people small enough to demonstrate correct building scale.
Avoid: additional floors, oversized people, extra buildings, unrelated set dressing, text, numbers, dimension arrows, labels, user interface, logos, emblems, brands, watermarks. Image is a concept, not a technical dimensioned drawing.
View A: orient the long glazed front toward the viewer, show the outside stair along the visible short side and the skybridge leaving the rear far corner. Keep all of these in frame. Landscape aspect ratio, high resolution.

tasks.title: Wall bays
tasks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Input images 1-4 are supporting design references: research park terrace, campus overhead, river crossing, robotics lab. Match their contemporary white composite architecture, slim black steel, clean glass and pale stone. Do not copy logos, emblems or signage.
Style: precise realistic architectural product render with readable edges, plausible connections, slight material texture, soft even neutral studio illumination on a seamless plain mid-grey background. Entire requested object(s) visible with clear margin; controlled soft ground shadow. No people, no surrounding campus, no night sky, no text, no labels, no numbers, no dimension lines, no logos, no emblems, no watermarks.
Shared size constraints: every panel edge, seam and structural mullion uses a 1.5 m module; storey height is 4.5 m floor to floor. Keep scale and construction internally consistent.
Primary request: one wide sheet of FOUR wall-bay components side by side, same baseline, same scale, front orthographic elevation with no perspective convergence. Each bay is 1.5 m wide and 4.5 m tall; make their 1:3 width-to-height proportions clear. Leave modest plain-grey gaps between components.
Left to right: (1) solid matte white composite panel bay with thin dark seams at 1.5 m grid intervals; (2) floor-to-ceiling clear glass bay in a slim black frame, with structural/transom divisions at the same 1.5 m grid; (3) black-framed glass door bay with a small dark access reader, regular door below glazed transom filling the 4.5 m storey; (4) outer-corner wall-bay component where white composite on one face meets black-framed glass on the perpendicular face. For this corner only allow a slight three-quarter turn to reveal the return; keep its vertical height and module consistent with the three elevations. Every component has a light stone base strip and slim black cap. High resolution landscape sheet, no text.

tasks.title: Target frame C, fewer lights and less greenery
tasks.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: targeted revision of Request 31 architecture target frame C for Bryson's direct feedback: "there's far too many lights, and everything is too bright, and there's far too much greenery."
Image 1 is the exact edit target. Preserve the same building identity, compact two-storey massing, camera angle, composition and framing, white panel and black glass materials, roof-edge shape, complete left outside staircase, short glass skybridge stub at right, TWO rooftop air-handling units, one solar panel row, EXACTLY THREE small crouching Operators with backpack computers, bench, paving pattern, thin red accent, and structural geometry.
Change ONLY lighting/exposure and planting density:
1. DRAMATICALLY FEWER LIGHTS. Remove all repetitive garden lights, bollard lights, glowing planter rims, stair lights and the ring of path lights around the building. Keep the one tall pole light as a single subdued pool of practical illumination, and at most TWO discreet, dim wall uplights. No continuously glowing perimeter, no decorative fairy-lights effect. Keep only tiny dim red equipment indicators.
2. MUCH DARKER NIGHT EXPOSURE. This is a stealth-tactics research facility at night, quiet and mostly dark. Dark cool blue-grey ambient fill lets the building silhouette, stair and paths remain legible, but most ground and the roof are in shadow. White panels should look soft cool grey under night sky, not blazing white or orange. Keep warm light in only a FEW small lab work areas behind glass; most interior bays are unlit/dim. The skybridge has one subdued warm linear interior light, not a bright glowing lantern. Reduce warm spill and bloom strongly. No glaring highlights, no golden floodlight wash.
3. RESTRAINED WET REFLECTIONS. Preserve wet paving but make it dark damp stone with faint local reflections near the few remaining fixtures, not a mirror-bright golden plaza. No huge bright reflection patches.
4. REMOVE ABOUT 85 PERCENT OF VISIBLE GREENERY. Remove the dense foreground and background ornamental bushes, trees, repeated ground planters and luxuriant rooftop trees. Clear most of the apron to plain light stone paving that now reads dark at night. On the roof keep ONLY one narrow sparse low green-roof strip and TWO small plain planters with low grasses; no tall rooftop shrubs or trees. Outside the apron at the distant edge allow just a few restrained low plants or one distant tree silhouette. Keep the same setting, but make it an uncluttered modern research facility rather than a lush landscaped resort.
The image should feel noticeably, substantially darker and sparser than image 1, while retaining readable paths and the exact original architecture. Avoid changes to building design, extra objects, extra floors, camera cropping, text, labels, logos, emblems or watermarks.
